# GLM task 004 — READ-ONLY audit of the F0 code against the FROZEN contract (role result-auditor). Do NOT edit any file; do not run anything long.
Inputs (read in full): contracts/F0_CONTRACT.md (FROZEN v2; sections 2,3,5,6,7), src/f0_config.py, src/omega.py, src/gsfit.py, src/plin.py, src/df_est.py, src/synth.py, src/reference_eval.py, tests/test_f0_units.py, experiments/f0_run.py, experiments/f0_analyze.py. Write your report ONLY as your final answer (the harness stores it); do not write files.
Report a numbered findings list. For each: file:line, severity (BLOCKER = would make results wrong/invalid, MAJOR, MINOR), the concrete evidence (quote the line), and what the contract says. Only report what you verified by reading code; say "not verified" otherwise. No claims about experimental results (none exist).
Checks:
1. LEAKAGE: gsfit.py/plin.py must not import synth or reference_eval, nor read files/env/global state; the runner must never pass x, e, or the clean image into any fitter call (fit_pipeline, fit_no_birth, plin_*). The antithetic fit uses y_minus = x - e built in the runner: confirm only the vector y_minus (not x) is passed.
2. SEED INDEPENDENCE: noise stream 1 [img,m], omega stream 2 [img,m] (init = sub-stream 0, round r = 1+r), probe streams 3/6/9/11 must not depend on S. fix omega (stream 8) must not depend on m or S. N0/P-lin use their own streams. torch's global RNG must not be used for anything that affects results. No use of time/hash()/os.urandom.
3. R1 REPLAY: fit_pipeline has ONE code path with an optional forced_idx; forced run must reproduce the data-selected run bit-for-bit (same op order, birth pixels ascending); the runner asserts np.array_equal for EVERY m and aborts on failure; the perturbed FD fit uses the same omega and forced_idx; FD_m = b^T(g_I(y+eps_f b)-f(y))/eps_f with eps_f = rel*sigma0 (absolute), base term = f(y), not a re-fit.
4. ESTIMATORS: df_oracle^rand = (1/(M s^2)) sum_i sum_m (F-Fbar)E ; sdf = df - mean FD; antithetic = <f(x+e)-f(x-e), e>/(2 s^2); MC div_hat = b^T(f(y+eps b;omega)-f(y;omega))/eps with the SAME omega and eps absolute = rel*sigma0; sigma' resimulation uses sigma'=sqrt(s^2+(rel s)^2) for BOTH noise scale and the df normaliser. Check signs, normalisers, float64 everywhere, no clipping / nan_to_num.
5. CONTRACT CONFORMANCE of experiments/f0_run.py: S grid (8,16,64,256,1024); nested candidates = first S of per-round permutation; b=8 x 3 rounds; steps 150/stage; M=256; Mmc=64 with J=2 and all 5 eps; T3 cells only eps in {0.3,1.0}, S in {8,256}, 256 samples both sides; fix family 4 omega x 128; conv (2x steps) only D1 S in {8,1024}; pilot sizes; P-lin 1024 atoms, W0=zeros, W1=0.1*D1; V7 exact full-coordinate FD; cap 4 h (pilot 30 min); contract hash check; atomic output dir.
6. CONTRACT CONFORMANCE of experiments/f0_analyze.py section 6/7 rules: V3 on W0 only; V6 threshold max(3SE,0.03df) for S=8 and N0; H1 (a)(c) thresholds (4 SE_diff, 0.05 df, slope lower 95%); H2 (i) 0.05, (ii) excess var 0.01 df^2, (iii) SE_J2 0.05 df with Mmc=64, (iv) cost 3; pilot order INVALID -> STOP (upper 1.645 SE < 0.02 df and P-lin pass) -> power REDESIGN (z_proj<4; rerun M=128 else INCONCLUSIVE) -> wall-clock REDESIGN (4 h) -> PROCEED; paired bootstrap shares the index matrix across S arms; NaN handling (a NaN must never lead to PROCEED).
7. TESTS: does tests/test_f0_units.py really test what the spec says (bitwise determinism, forced replay, S==b y-independence, nested candidates, gradient vs finite differences, hard-threshold toy identities, GN trace, P-lin rank and exact FD 1e-6, antithetic unbiasedness)? Any test that cannot fail?
8. Anything else that could silently bias sdf(S) upward or downward with S (e.g. a place where the data-dependent selection enters g_I, a y-dependent random draw, an S-dependent RNG consumption).
Final answer format: a table of findings sorted by severity, then a short "not verified" list.
